title: Talking to Claude
goal: Type a wish to your AI helper. Watch it answer!
mascot_lines: Claude is a kind helper that reads what you type and writes back.
You can ask Claude to make pictures, tell stories, or solve a problem.
Try the chat below — type something like 'make me a star' and press Ask.
Whatever you ask for, Claude will try its best.

sandbox.hint: Type 'make me a star' or 'draw a heart'.

payload.prompt: Now you try! Type the magic words below.

tier2.rephrase: You need to type the magic words. Look at the gray box for the words.

tier3.nudge: Type the small words from the box, exactly like you see them.
